requirements.text: Currently enrolled in a graduate degree program (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative field).
Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative field.
Foundational proficiency in Python and standard software development best practices (version control/Git, writing modular code).
Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and core Generative AI patterns (e.g., prompt engineering, agentic workflows, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
Awareness of AI safety principles, output reliability, and the importance of compliance in high-stakes environments like biotechnology and healthcare.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
Academic projects or coursework involving LLM API integration or open-source AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or building with commercial/open-source APIs).
Experience or strong interest in system evaluation, benchmarking, or testing (e.g., setting up test cases, evaluating model accuracy/consistency, or unit testing agent steps).
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an eagerness to experiment in a fast-paced environment.
